messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — nightly perf dashboard just alerted. p50 token latency jumped ~40% between 02:12 and 02:18 UTC. noticed batcher queuing up and GPU util hitting 98%.
ops-bot: [ALERT] nightly-perf: p50_latency +42% | batcher_queue_depth +5x | hosts: rwd-rt-*-gpu | link: https://dash.redwood/p/nightly/214365
Maria Gomez: I saw a correlated KV hit-rate drop on the same window. hotset working set shrank, eviction rate up.
Jin Park: Any new merges around midnight? I'll start a quick git bisect on staging perf runs.
Alex Chen: Merge a7b1c3b (kernel-scorer: add icost penalty) went in at 23:50 PT. Could be related — changes kernel selection heuristics.
Samir Patel: CI had a flaky perf job earlier: `ci-bot: perf/regression: staging-kernel-suite failed p95 1.18x` but we marked as noise.
Maria Gomez: Quote from profiler around 02:15: heavy spins in batcher scheduler waiting on KV lookups. Flame: `batcher_loop -> schedule -> kv_lookup -> kernel_choose`
Jin Park: Dump from one host (sanitized):
```
batcher.queue_depth: 128
kv.lookup.latency_p95: 230ms
kernel_selector.score_delta: +3.1 (favoring small-seq kernels)
gpu_util: 98%
```
Alex Chen: Interesting — kernel_selector now prefers a small-sequence kernel that doesn't reuse KV as aggressively, so the per-request KV pressure spikes and batching stalls.
Samir Patel: If kernel choice increases KV misses, batcher backs up and we hit tail latency. That aligns.
Maria Gomez: I've started an ablation on staging: revert the icost penalty in a7b1c3b and run the staging nightly suite.
ci-bot: queued perf-run: staging-nightly-214365-revert-test (ID: pr-3899)
Jin Park: Meanwhile, can we patch a temporary fallback? Maybe prefer legacy kernel when kv_hit_rate < 0.8. Small change, low-risk.
Alex Chen: +1 for hotfix toggle. Maria/Jin — if you can ship a feature flag we can flip quickly during rollout.
Maria Gomez: Pushed `hotfix/kv-fallback-flag` to canary, config: `kernel_selector.prefer_legacy_on_kv_drop=true`. Rolling to 10% now.
ops-bot: Deploy event: canary +10% -> 2026-03-18T03:05:12Z by MariaG
Samir Patel: Canary looks healthy after flip: p50 down 28%, batcher queue depth normalized.
Jin Park: Bisect results: revert of a7b1c3b restores previous profile. Likely root cause.
Alex Chen: Good. Next steps: revert commit a7b1c3b from main, add an integration test simulating hotset shifts + kernel selection, and follow up with improved scoring that accounts for kv_reuse factor.
Maria Gomez: Filing a formal rollback PR and a follow-up issue: PERF-2147. I'll include perf traces and the staging run artifacts.
Samir Patel: We'll keep the feature flag in place until scoring is reworked. Also add a nightly regression test to catch this.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Adding action items here: 1) Maria — rollback PR + artifacts (ETA 2h). 2) Jin — add regression test + bisect notes. 3) Samir — monitor production nightdash and keep flag togglable.
Maria Gomez: Done — PR opened: https://git.redwood/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3910 (rollback a7b1c3b).
ci-bot: perf job finished: staging-nightly-214365-revert-test -> p50 restored to baseline, p95 improved.
Alex Chen: Closing triage for now. Will re-run full merge candidate once scoring patch is ready. :white_check_mark:
